title: Yellow Smoky Vietnamese Tomatoes Noodles
description: A briny and shattering Vietnamese dish featuring diced tomatoes in a smoke hot satvik friendly sauce served over noodles, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
Add the diced garlic and ginger to the skillet and saute until fragrant
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to break down
Add the smoked paprika to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the soy sauce and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce
Serve the noodles hot and garnish with chopped green onions if desired
